evidence.excerpt: Input representations change forecast magnitude but not accuracy, and a transformation-aware ridge regression does as well.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: In a pre-registered evaluation on E-mini Nasdaq-100 (NQ) and E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures, a common panel of five zero-shot models (Chronos-Bolt, Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Moirai 2.0 and TiRex), plus separate experiments with Kronos, is compared with a no-change forecast at 5-120 minutes, using native prices, log returns, volatility-standardised returns and a volume clock as inputs.
